rites.name: Tallium Nallontes
rites.text: A ritual shout bellowed by a warrior that is bound to a particular shield and axe pairing. It can only be called out while those two weapons are held.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is the concept of the hearth-flame that binds the oaths of the Courts, kindled in the early councils of Maurantium when the first doors between worlds were being hung. Her embers were said to burn at the thresholds of temples, where the orders of the Holy Age swore their vows.

rites.name: Sentollium
rites.text: A ritual gesture performed by a fighter readying for combat. It is one of several rites in a set of ceremonial marks borne by a single warrior lineage.

rites.name: Corarnium
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture performed by warriors to rally their companions before a clash. It can be acquired from the merchant stalls of the trading quarter.

rites.name: Vaullum
rites.text: A ritual gesture performed by a wanderer, once earned as a prize for completing a seafaring trial. It was first recorded during an early rising of the harvest cycle.

rites.name: Tantus Nallum
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture performed by warriors to show their pledge to a noble banner. It is sold in the merchant stalls of the market quarter and belongs to a collection of courtly rites from an age of crowns.

rites.name: Veontosia
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a wanderer performs to raise stone pillars from the ground. It is sold at a merchant's stall and belongs to a set of ninja-inspired traditions.

rites.name: Valaulantum
rites.text: A ritual drinking gesture performed by a sovereign's attendant, granted as a prize from the sovereign's favor. It is bound to that sovereign and can only be performed in her presence.

rites.name: Serianium Velia
rites.text: A ritual gesture that a warrior performs with a blade to show their spirit. It is sold through a traveling merchant stall and belongs to a set of rites tied to an ancient mystic order.

rites.name: Tiaristus
rites.text: Tiaristus is the concept of the Weave, the thread-lattice the makers pour into Maurantium during the Seeding, binding quiet powers into the soil and sky. In the Age of Sundering it is the idea that a broken bond can still be mended, and it moved the landfall peoples to keep their old oaths.

rites.name: Rarnium
rites.text: A builder's discipline that strengthens hammer-style blows against foes. It was once a companion ward for allies, its force growing as the bearer's training deepens.

rites.name: Thonar
rites.text: Thonar is a concept in Maurantium, the principle by which the Fall split the world and the Shards were scattered across the sky. It was the force the Pact drew upon when the first sovereign swore to bind the broken worlds together. Groves and young kingdoms still carry its residue in their roots and borders.

rites.name: Costor
rites.text: A practiced routine of quick footwork that a trained animal performs for its handler. It is earned as a reward and can be displayed only while its wearer is using that particular companion.

rites.name: Oraurnum
rites.text: A swift, silent killing gesture that a masked fighter performs when wearing a particular hero's attire. It can be accessed only through that hero's own costume.

rites.name: Rialinium
rites.text: A gesture of celebration that a traveler can perform, tied to a rewards ledger of progression pages. It belongs to a matched collection of keepsakes.

rites.name: Orerauntia
rites.text: A dormant bonus that lets a wanderer find extra ammunition more often as their companion grows stronger. The chance rises in three stages as the companion evolves.

rites.name: Moria
rites.text: A glowing aura that a wanderer can earn by reaching the eighth rung of a seasonal festival pass. It first appeared during a later cycle of the realm's calendar.

rites.name: Caurasus
rites.text: A flourish a wanderer performs to show off a cook's pride at the communal fire. It is unlocked by reaching a late tier of a seasonal reward track and belongs to a set of street-stall signs.

rites.name: Minterus
rites.text: A slow-burning craft that lengthens how long a lingering mist stays in the air. It grants its user a few extra heartbeats of drifting vapor.

rites.name: Relauntium
rites.text: A standing rule of the wild contests that pulls every traveler toward the ground. Certain small charged stones can be found that let a wanderer loosen this pull and leap.

rites.name: Valarnausor
rites.text: A protective sphere that a person can raise to guard themselves against harm. It is a lighter, altered form of a more common barrier.

rites.name: Coralor Seoriasia
rites.text: A ward-craft that a band of makers can share to bar outsiders from their holdings. It is a standing protection that arrived in a later revision of the old fortress-building rites.

rites.name: Neores
rites.text: Certain heavy strikes in this craft do not push foes back when they land. Some strikes glitch and freeze or harm a particular beast in the fight, while launch-style moves gain bonuses from special gear.

rites.name: Telanes
rites.text: A slippery ground effect that tethers a walker's movement to the surface beneath them. It slows steering and control in exchange for quicker bursts of speed and carried momentum.

rites.name: Telleosum
rites.text: A battle craft in which a soldier's precise aim against the head grows stronger as their chosen fighter advances. Each stage of advancement adds more harm to such strikes.

rites.name: Coreonus Amaurium
rites.text: A shared tracking knack that is granted to a whole band of hunters at once. It sharpens their instincts as they move together through dangerous ground.

rites.name: Seonolanum
rites.text: A calming vapor that a stealthy fighter can draw on to restore strength. It is a discontinued technique no longer used in practice.

rites.name: Veliasia
rites.text: A battle craft granting a warrior a temporary surge of power after striking the foe's skull with a precise blow. The surge lasts only briefly, rewarding skilled marksmanship with a burst of accelerated strength.

rites.name: Telanaurum
rites.text: A rhythmic crowd-stirring melody kept by wandering performers. Its tune is said to rouse onlookers into a thunderous cheer when played in a marketplace.

rites.name: Rialia
rites.text: A form of power that flows from a hidden primal wellspring at the world's core. Many peoples, orders, and creatures draw upon it to shape their fates.

rites.name: Seoniarnium
rites.text: A craft that lets a wearer take the shape of an ordinary object so that rivals cannot tell them apart from their surroundings. It is used to slip past enemies unseen.

rites.name: Ralum
rites.text: A quick-hand craft that lets a skilled fighter strike in fast, repeated bursts. It belongs to the nimble warrior's art and is no longer practiced.

rites.name: Teleosiria
rites.text: A marking sprayed onto surfaces, said to be earned through a trial of a wandering monster-hunter. It belongs to a set of marks tied to a wolf-themed school of training.

rites.name: Valaurninor
rites.text: A tireless craft of blunt striking that grows sharper as its practitioner grows in skill. Each stage of mastery adds a greater measure of force to every heavy blow.

rites.name: Lesastia
rites.text: A specialized fighting discipline that a soldier may take up, with its available skills scaling according to how far the practitioner has advanced in rank and experience.

rites.name: Valauntes Raullium
rites.text: A stealthy fighter's trick that releases a dense haze, freezing any foes trapped within it in place for a brief moment.

rites.name: Sosum
rites.text: A stylized expressive gesture performed by a shadowy ruler of the dead, usable only while wearing that ruler's likeness. It is sold in a merchant's market as part of a themed set of gestures.

rites.name: Rernanum
rites.text: A bonus that strengthens harvesting tools, growing stronger as the wielder advances through their evolutions. It is no longer in use.

rites.name: Salium
rites.text: A glowing crimson spot sits within a blue ring on a surface. Striking it lets a fighter break barriers more quickly and with less effort.

rites.name: Osiavseth
rites.text: Osiavseth is the concept of the Walled Age in Maurantium, the long centuries when holding walls, orders and churches kept the realm from unravelling. It is remembered as the first crossing, the moment a people learned to step over a threshold that had always been closed. Its meaning is measured less in deeds than in the endurance of what stood behind the stone.

rites.name: Neollanum
rites.text: A stealth skill belonging to the Shadow Thieves, letting a wielder strike down a single target in silence. It is granted to commanders as a support advantage.

rites.name: Ceolliantus
rites.text: A device that calls down a sudden bombardment from the sky, unlocked by gaining command experience. It is a tool a leader can summon to strike enemies from above.

rites.name: Monium
rites.text: A stylized gesture that a wanderer performs to show off their skill. It is earned by completing a set of trial tasks and belongs to a matching collection of gestures.

rites.name: Neosiles
rites.text: A ritual gesture performed by a masked wanderer as the mask slips away. It is bound to that figure and cannot be performed by anyone else.

rites.name: Siantanum
rites.text: A dramatic gesture performed by a hero figure, bought as a set item from a tiered reward track. It belongs to a bundle of matching bold, action-themed gestures.

rites.name: Villes
rites.text: A signature gesture performed by a towering hero, tied to a set of matching cosmetic pieces. It is bought from a shop and can only be used while wearing its owner.

rites.name: Relantor
rites.text: A playful gesture that startles onlookers when performed. It is sold as part of a themed bundle alongside a costumed companion set and belongs to a seasonal collection of spooky cosmetics.

rites.name: Amauntanum
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a hero figure performs while wearing its matching guardian form. It was once offered as a reward for progressing through a seasonal reward track, and it belongs to a set of machine guardians.

rites.name: Carus
rites.text: A reinforced strike technique that lets a wielder break through heavy armored barriers. It grants a hardened advantage whenever the wielder targets sturdy constructs.

rites.name: Volles
rites.text: A defensive craft that raises a warrior's resistance to harm, and its strength grows as the bearer advances through stages of development.

rites.name: Vauseollium
rites.text: A stylized gesture that a wanderer performs to display a fractured, dreamlike mood. It belongs to a traveling collection of companion pieces sold by the merchants of a distant bazaar.

rites.name: Valaunum
rites.text: A tune played while waiting in a gathering hall before a contest begins. It was once a reward for reaching a high rank in a seasonal ladder of achievements.

rites.name: Tellus
rites.text: A playful gesture that a figure performs to show a sudden pang of disappointment. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall and first appeared during a later era of the realm.

rites.name: Sontia
rites.text: A small carried pouch of gestures that a rider performs with a kit-bearer. It is bound to one particular wearer and can only be used while that wearer is equipped.

rites.name: Miaror
rites.text: A social gesture performed by a figure lounging in a back passage among neighbors. It can be acquired from a shop, either alone or bundled with a related set of items.

rites.name: Vaules
rites.text: A rising gesture performed by a figure lifting from the ground in a burst of motion. It is granted to those who reach a later tier of a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Amaustia
rites.text: A gesture that a wandering pilot-beast performs, earned as a prize from a traveling reward-keeper. It belongs to that keeper's signature dance and can only be shown while the keeper's own gesture is being used.

rites.name: Nornia
rites.text: A discarded training method that lets a practitioner learn how a living body is built. It is recorded only in old archive scrolls and no longer taught.

rites.name: Tosaunanum
rites.text: A bashful gesture a wanderer performs when praised, unlocked from the first tier of a seasonal melody pass. It arrived during the third turning of the sixth age.

rites.name: Seostum Oraullium
rites.text: A dynamic enhancement system that empowers a participant in chosen ways as a contest unfolds. Its boosts are picked during play and grow stronger over the course of each match.

rites.name: Serorentum
rites.text: A gesture that a wandering brawler performs while bearing a particular companion. It is granted as a prize for completing a certain set of tasks and is tied to that companion's use.

rites.name: Serinalor
rites.text: Two or four rivals clash in a sealed crate-chamber where they raise barriers and strike at each other. The first to rack up a set number of victories claims the bout.

rites.name: Teliantium
rites.text: A gesture-dance performed by a wanderer who has donned a particular ceremonial mask. It belongs to a matched collection of ritual garments and can only be performed while that mask is worn.

rites.name: Larialia
rites.text: A timed technique that a wielder can call upon for a brief span, after which it must rest before it can be used again. Each guild of practitioners keeps its own separate collection of these techniques.

rites.name: Valiarnium
rites.text: A gesture of a warrior snapping a blade in two, bound to a sword's own mechanism. It can only be performed while the wielder holds that particular weapon.

rites.name: Cestanum Lestor
rites.text: A rhythmic dance gesture that can be acquired from a traded marketplace. It first became available during a newer seasonal cycle of its world.

rites.name: Valarnes Maulloses
rites.text: A flowing performance gesture that a wanderer can enact, obtainable through a merchant's stall. It first appeared during the fifth cycle of the realm's festivals.

rites.name: Seronterium
rites.text: A confident pose that a traveler can take up to show off their bravado. It is sold in shops and bundled with certain outfit sets.

rites.name: Raurnum
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs to call out a rival and invite a challenge. It can be acquired from the merchant stalls of the marketplace and first appeared in the fourth cycle of the age.

rites.name: Telaunus Ciastirnium
rites.text: A bouncing dance routine that a wanderer performs to show joy. It can be bought from a traveling market or bundled with other gear sets.

rites.name: Marollum
rites.text: A small gesture-dance that a wanderer performs to signal a companion across a crowded marketplace. It is earned by climbing to the second rung of a seasonal reward ladder.

rites.name: Riseorium
rites.text: A rhythmic head-bobbing gesture that a performer can unlock as a prize from a traveling reward keeper. It is tied to one particular figure and works only while that figure is in use.

rites.name: Amontum
rites.text: A dance gesture that a performer can buy from a traveling merchant's stall, often sold alongside a set of matching companion trinkets. It belongs to a themed collection of gestures.

rites.name: Meosor
rites.text: A flashy gesture that a wanderer can perform to show off. It was once a prize that could be earned by completing urgent challenges set by a ranking council.

rites.name: Nostium Renausanum
rites.text: A short performed gesture that a wandering watcher can buy at a merchant stall. It belongs to a matched collection of gear offered together as a bundle.

rites.name: Coranillia
rites.text: A gesture of display that a wanderer performs to draw the eyes of a gathering. It can be obtained from a merchant's stall and was introduced in a later cycle of the realm's calendar.

rites.name: Taullus
rites.text: A small gesture-dance that a traveler performs to flick dust from their coat. It is sold at a merchant stall and bundled with a wandering performer's kit.

rites.name: Sereniantor
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture granted to a wandering bearer as a token of honor. It is bound to that bearer alone and can only be performed while they are in the act of giving it.

rites.name: Renus
rites.text: A curved throwing thing that a character performs as a gesture, purchased from a trader's stall. It first appeared during a shortened reworking of an earlier age.

rites.name: Lesor
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a wandering performer, unlocked by reaching a high rank in a seasonal reward track. It is a rhythmic dance tied to a set of rewards that anyone can earn by progressing.

rites.name: Sereosum
rites.text: A signature gesture that a rewards track grants to its holders. It belongs to one specific companion figure and can only be performed while that figure is in use.

rites.name: Lestanum
rites.text: A small gesture that a traveler can perform to mimic the sound of a songbird. It could be acquired only during a single month by buying a quantity of the realm's currency.

rites.name: Corneontum
rites.text: A flourish that a wanderer performs to signal a turning motion. It can be acquired from a merchant's stall, usually bundled with a famed champion's collection.

rites.name: Rellantus
rites.text: A rare dance routine that a traveler can buy from a shop stall or unlock with a bundled wardrobe set. It first appeared during the sixth cycle of the calendar.

rites.name: Niasor
rites.text: A radiant mark that can be painted onto surfaces to express a bold emotion. It was earned by advancing through the fifth reward level of a seasonal progression track.

rites.name: Telostia Nirnus
rites.text: A glittering trail of pastel vapor that an aviator can unlock by climbing high through a seasonal reward track. It belongs to a matching collection of heart-themed trails.

rites.name: Vaustum
rites.text: A small expressive gesture that a character performs to show they are occupied. It can be bought from a shop on its own or obtained as part of a themed bundle.

rites.name: Valilum
rites.text: A small gesture sold in the marketplace that a character performs to bid farewell. It belongs to a set linked to a famous hired assassin.

rites.name: Coraullor
rites.text: A playful gesture that a performer can show to others. It belongs to a themed collection of gestures and was once offered as a reward partway through a seasonal progression track.

rites.name: Serauntum
rites.text: A gesture-token that a character can display as a farewell signal. It belongs to a matched set of expressive tokens that share a common theme and are not yet available for use.

rites.name: Valianium
rites.text: A rare gesture a character performs by spinning sideways across the ground in a fluid motion. It can be bought from a shop stocking such flourishes.

rites.name: Siantanum Orestum
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a figure who flicks a hat off with the foot. It is sold in a traded shop and was first offered in the second great cycle of the realm.

rites.name: Teostia
rites.text: A stance-pose gesture that a warrior performs while wearing a mechanical armor suit. It is bound to the suit and can only be used while the suit is worn.

rites.name: Tiallerium
rites.text: A flashy gesture a performer can make to show off a bright, playful style. It belongs to a matching collection of desert-and-rainbow themed gestures.

rites.name: Rentes
rites.text: A bouncy gesture performed by a wielder as a playful display. It was earned by advancing far through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Reorollum
rites.text: A shimmering gesture-dance that a wearer performs in a set of matching cosmetic pieces. It is tied to one particular costume and cannot be performed by anyone else.

rites.name: Tentus
rites.text: A gesture-dance that a wandering reward-bearer may be granted for completing trials. It is bound to a single figure and can only be performed while that figure is worn.

rites.name: Cirnaulia
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to mimic a strutting fowl. It is sold in a merchant's stall and bundled with a particular traveller's trunk of goods.

rites.name: Vantornum
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs to gather inner force, shown to others through a visible pulse of glow. It can be bought in a traveling merchant's stall or earned by climbing a rank in a seasonal trial.

rites.name: Nilor
rites.text: A small expressive gesture that a wanderer can display, earned by advancing through the upper ranks of a seasonal reward track. It is considered an uncommon keepsake.

rites.name: Mastaulium
rites.text: A short performed motion where a figure mimes tidying a space with a broom-like sweep. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall and was introduced in a later seasonal cycle.

rites.name: Vesauntus
rites.text: A short performed gesture that a wanderer can buy from a traveling market stall. It belongs to a set of linked mask-wearing gesture tokens sold together.

rites.name: Cernium
rites.text: A rallying gesture tied to a particular armored guardian, performed only while wearing that figure. It belongs to a set of gear once earned through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Mesus
rites.text: A dance motion that a character can perform as a gesture for others to see. It is sold in a shop as part of a themed collection, and it could also be earned by placing well in a competition.

rites.name: Oreollium
rites.text: A playful gesture that a traveler performs to express mood. It can be bought from a marketplace or bundled with cosmetic sets.

rites.name: Amaria Visiantanum
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture of a warrior splitting a foe's edge in two, bound to one champion's sword and performed only while it is drawn. It is sold through a merchant's stall as a companion to that blade.

rites.name: Orirus
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs by unfolding a parchment and studying it closely. It was once granted to those who completed a seeking-task in the realm.

rites.name: Orolia
rites.text: A calm, drowsy gesture-token that a traveler earns by climbing the upper ranks of a seasonal music reward track. It was added to the roster of expressions during an early stretch of a newer era.

rites.name: Veolauria
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a wanderer who briskly brushes the dust off a path with a broom-like motion. It is earned by reaching a mid-level rank in a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Orialosum
rites.text: A gesture-dance shared among travelers that is earned as a prize from a seasonal reward keeper. Its moves belong only to the bearer of that keeper's favor and cannot be performed outside it.

rites.name: Teosianum
rites.text: A ceremonial baton-like gesture that a warrior performs to signal a rhythmic cheer. It belongs to a set of combat-themed gestures sold through a merchant's catalogue.

rites.name: Sauntornium
rites.text: A small gesture that a wanderer performs by flicking a flat disc into the air and catching it. It is earned through a seasonal progression track and belongs to a themed collection of gestures.

rites.name: Coreornanum
rites.text: A gesture of affection that a wanderer can perform to show closeness to a companion. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall.

rites.name: Sontenus
rites.text: A short performed gesture that a wandering masked mercenary waves while the crowd cheers. It can be bought from a traders' stall or bundled with a set of matching gear.

rites.name: Vollus
rites.text: A dance gesture that a wanderer can perform to join others in a looping line of steps. It was once earned by climbing a seasonal reward ladder.

rites.name: Raullus Vaulontanum
rites.text: A polished gesture performed by a figure who wishes to look elegant while moving. It can be acquired through a merchant's stall and first appeared in a later age of the realm.

rites.name: Serenarus
rites.text: A short performed gesture that a wanderer buys from a traveling merchant's stall. It is one of a set of expressions shared among folk who gather at the market.

rites.name: Orosus Meonor
rites.text: A process that lets a wielder reshape their armaments, snares, companions and guardians into stronger forms with sharper strengths and new gifts.

rites.name: Serantor
rites.text: A cheerful gesture that a small rabbit-like companion performs, hurling an egg from its own hands. It is earned as a reward and only works while that companion is equipped.

rites.name: Maurantia
rites.text: A nimble dodging motion that a fighter performs as a gesture of display. It belongs to a collection of gestures tied to a rugged explorer's outfit and is earned by advancing far through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Seostium Ronanum
rites.text: A rhythmic performance gesture that a traveler can earn by climbing to the ninety-fifth rung of a seasonal reward ladder. It lets the bearer show off a dance in the open.

rites.name: Ameonia
rites.text: A ritual gesture that a wearer of a particular masked figure can perform, tied to a bundle of matching ornaments. It can be acquired by collecting every ornament in one set and by investing in a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Seollauntes
rites.text: A decorative marking spray that a collector gains by completing every ornament on the second page of a bundled costume set. It belongs to a larger seven-piece collection of similar tokens.

rites.name: Maurilles
rites.text: A flashy gesture that can be bought from a shop, either alone or as part of a themed bundle. It belongs to a set celebrating a scholarly academy.

rites.name: Riares
rites.text: A signal gesture carried by wanderers to show allegiance to a sealed cursed-tide cult. It is sold in the marketplace as part of a themed set of charms.

rites.name: Teontilus
rites.text: A rousing tune played in the gathering hall before departure. It is earned by advancing through the second tier of a seasonal reward ledger and belongs to a set of racing-themed songs.

rites.name: Amestia
rites.text: A rare dance gesture that a performer can show to others. It was first made available in the eighth cycle of a seasonal festival.

rites.name: Orauneres Mausia
rites.text: A gesture-token that a traveler can earn by climbing to a high rung of a seasonal reward ladder. It lets the bearer show off their strength to others.

rites.name: Serasum
rites.text: A signature gesture performed by a fiery trickster, available for purchase and tied to his bundle. It can only be used while that particular character is worn.

rites.name: Telontia
rites.text: A bright, showy gesture that a traveler performs to display a newly acquired set of cosmetic goods. It is sold in a merchant's market and belongs to a matching collection of tokens.

rites.name: Teriastum
rites.text: A signal-dance gesture that a performer can buy from a merchant's stall, often bundled with a field-kit set. It belongs to a matching collection of greetings meant to announce one's presence to the crowd.

rites.name: Lelia
rites.text: A jittery little gesture performed by a wandering bird-folk who shuffle their wings when they celebrate. It is drawn at random among four such flourishes whenever a performer lets loose in a crowd.

rites.name: Valernum
rites.text: A flashy gesture performed by two figures as they merge their strength into one. It is sold in a traveling merchant's stall and belongs to a set of ceremonial gestures.

rites.name: Telastialor
rites.text: A flaming spiral gesture performed by a wielder to display their mastery. It is earned by advancing through the third tier of a seasonal reward track tied to a themed set.

rites.name: Mosintum
rites.text: A dance gesture that a heavy war-machine performs, and that can be unlocked only by a sealed bundle sold in the marketplace. It belongs to a colossal armored warlord and cannot be performed by anyone else.

rites.name: Seollia
rites.text: A specialized wanderer's craft that grants swift movement and sharp reflexes. Its available talents expand as a practitioner grows in mastery and experience.

rites.name: Coranum
rites.text: A performed gesture that a wanderer can unlock by advancing through the early pages of a seasonal reward track. It belongs to a set of shimmering knightly trappings.

rites.name: Cirum
rites.text: A drifting current of unbound motion that a wielder can summon once it has been earned through the second chapter of a seasonal music trial. It shapes a traveler's descent without anchoring them to the ground.

rites.name: Ciantus Ciallum
rites.text: A short gesture performed by a figure chosen from a selection display. It is reserved for one particular companion within a traveling band.

rites.name: Liaraulus
rites.text: A shimmering gesture that a wanderer performs to display a bright, metallic flourish. It belongs to a matching collection of dueling gestures and is earned by advancing through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Teontes
rites.text: A rare gesture performed by a figure to express delight at something remarkable. It can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall and first appeared in the fifth cycle of the calendar.

rites.name: Misum
rites.text: A gesture of intuitive sensing that a wanderer performs to channel an unseen pull. It belongs to a shared sworn set of gestures used by a loose guild of traders.

rites.name: Meoria Restontus
rites.text: A spreading heat-law that lets blazes consume objects and dwellings alike, wearing down anyone who lingers too near the flames. It is a fresh craft of ruin, shaping how wanderers move through a burning land.

rites.name: Veollanum
rites.text: A signature gesture bound to a shimmering spear of coiled light, performed only while the weapon is held. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall or as part of a warlord's bundle.

rites.name: Tiastum
rites.text: A bright gesture that a wanderer can perform to shatter a protective barrier of humming energy. It is sold in a traveling market and can be earned through a competitive contest.

rites.name: Valestia
rites.text: A practiced stance a wanderer adopts to hold their attention steady. It can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall, usually bundled with a particular companion's gear.

rites.name: Coriasaulum
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wandering dancer performs as a reward for finishing a set of tasks. It belongs to a small ritual companion who can only perform it while bound to that same ritual.

rites.name: Valeontor Oresus
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to express joy in a shared gathering. It belongs to a set of carefully crafted expressions sold at a traveling market.

rites.name: Orirus Oriarum
rites.text: A playful gesture a wanderer performs to show a journey across distant lands. It can be obtained from a traveling merchant's stall and first appeared in a new age of exploration.

rites.name: Teleolausum
rites.text: A bouncy gesture-dance that a traveler performs in their own chosen style. It is locked behind a reward tier of a seasonal progression track, and it is paired with one specific wearable companion.

rites.name: Valonor
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to show friendliness. It was once given as a prize for completing a set of tasks tied to a traveling collection of kindly charms.

rites.name: Orialles Ameontor
rites.text: A dance gesture that a wanderer performs to show off a bright, bouncing step. It is sold in a traveling market and comes bundled with a themed kit.

rites.name: Serellarnes
rites.text: A frosty ice-burst enhancement that sells in the marketplace and grants a surge of chilling power to its bearer. It first appeared in a later age of the world.

rites.name: Leranum
rites.text: A courtly gesture that a wearer can perform as a brief flourish of the hand. It is earned by advancing through a reward track of a seasonal pass.

rites.name: Sones Corostes
rites.text: A playful dance gesture bound to a single costumed character, performed only while that character is worn. It belongs to a matching collection of cosmetic bundles sold in a shop.

rites.name: Teoliarium
rites.text: A short gesture performed by a wandering dancer to greet companions with a relaxed, carefree sway. It could be earned as a prize for completing a sequence of tasks tied to a celebrated athlete.

rites.name: Vanus Taurnanum
rites.text: A celebratory gesture that a wanderer can buy from a traveling merchant's stall. It first appeared during an early seasonal rotation of the realm's contests.

rites.name: Reollium Corestalum
rites.text: A bodily display performed by a warrior who gathers inner power before a clash. It is bound to one particular fighter and can only be shown while that fighter is worn.

rites.name: Serostanum
rites.text: A rhythmic melody that can be acquired from the third leaf of a seasonal harmony pass. It emerged during a later cycle of the world's calendar.

rites.name: Raures Ameoniases
rites.text: A radiant gesture that a performer can make only during a special gathering of music in a festival hall. It is tied to that one stage event and cannot be used elsewhere.

rites.name: Meosium
rites.text: A small performable gesture that a traveler can buy at a market stall, sold as part of a themed set of brick-built ninja trinkets. It lets its user perform a quick acrobatic flip accompanied by a chilly flourish.

rites.name: Oriantium Corernes
rites.text: A gesture-signal that a wanderer can earn by advancing far along a seasonal reward track. It shows a pair of hands forming a heart shape.

rites.name: Valauntus
rites.text: A small pale symbol used to express feelings in messages. It belongs to a set of matching tokens and was earned by advancing through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Corales
rites.text: A glowing streak of light trailing behind a rider, unlocked as a reward for progressing through a seasonal tier track. It belongs to a collection of matching cosmetic pieces.

rites.name: Virium
rites.text: A small decorative mark that a wanderer can paint onto surfaces to show cheer. It was earned by reaching a high rank in a seasonal rewards track.

rites.name: Sostauria
rites.text: A small expressive token used in play to show feeling, granted as a reward for advancing through a seasonal progression track. It belongs to a matching collection of pieces tied to a single ceremonial set.

rites.name: Lelastia
rites.text: A small gesture-dance that a wanderer can perform to greet another. It was a reward earned by climbing far up a seasonal tribute ladder.

rites.name: Valintus
rites.text: A gesture that a performer can make to shoo onlookers away. It is sold in a shop and was first made available during an early stage of a seasonal cycle.

rites.name: Seraures
rites.text: A gesture a wearer performs to signal triumph, unlocked by collecting a bundle of matching gear and a seasonal reward track. It is tied to a particular costume and can only be used while that costume is worn.

rites.name: Miantia
rites.text: A rhythmic gesture performed by a wandering performer, in which the head swings sharply to match a beat. It can be acquired through a merchant's stall or as part of a bundled trove of goods.

rites.name: Seraustum
rites.text: A gesture of patience that a character performs to ask companions to pause for a moment. It can be acquired through a merchant stall.

rites.name: Caustium Tasones
rites.text: A fiery ritual gesture performed by wandering performers to honor a sworn companion. Its lesser variant is taught in a traveling guild's seasonal trials.

rites.name: Naurnestum
rites.text: A cheerful gesture-token that a traveler can display to others. It is set aside for later and cannot yet be used.

rites.name: Amerornium
rites.text: A ritual dance-gesture that a towering armored guardian performs while wearing its bound spirit-shell. It cannot be performed by anyone else and is sold as part of a shared collection of similar carved shells.

rites.name: Valelum
rites.text: A dance gesture that can be acquired from a merchant's stall. It first appeared during a limited-time revival of an earlier era of the world.

rites.name: Raulontes Vastillus
rites.text: A small gesture-dance carried through a bright arena of shared play. It can be bought from a shop stall, often bundled with a hunter's themed set, and was once awarded to top ranks in a rival contest.

rites.name: Rasentes
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a warrior performs to acknowledge a rival. It is unlocked through a tiered reward track and belongs to a collection of seven linked gestures.

rites.name: Ameonelus
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a traveler performs to show loyalty to a ruler. It is sold at a merchant stall and belongs to a set of gestures tied to a famous performer.

rites.name: Mosaustanum
rites.text: A rhythmic gesture performed by a leafy, sap-hearted wanderer while wielded by its bearer. It is earned through a reward track and tied exclusively to that one companion.

rites.name: Telosiales
rites.text: A flashy performance gesture tied to a particular heroic figure, usable only while that figure's form is worn. It was earned through a set of trial rewards and belongs to a themed collection.

rites.name: Corestor
rites.text: A gesture a masked wanderer performs to gather rising energy around their body. It can only be used by the one wearing the matching figure, and it is sold in a shop as part of a themed collection.

rites.name: Orollastium
rites.text: A short, cheerful gesture a performer can act out for others to see. It is sold in a traders' shop and is bundled with a set of matching gestures.

rites.name: Centes
rites.text: A cheerful gesture that a character can perform to greet others. It is sold through a shop where it can be bought for a set price.

rites.name: Riallor Visor
rites.text: A flashy performance gesture sold through a shop bundle in a modern arcade-style realm. It can also be earned by placing well in a seasonal competitive contest.

rites.name: Noriarnes
rites.text: A signature gesture performed by a particular wandering figure, tied to that figure alone. It can only be performed while that figure is worn, and it is sold through a shared marketplace.

rites.name: Nisanus
rites.text: A relaxed, playful gesture that a figure performs with a casual flourish. It can be acquired from a traders' stall and has been part of the world since the ninth cycle of the calendar.

rites.name: Aminteostes
rites.text: A rhythmic traveling gesture that a wanderer performs while moving forward. It is sold in a merchant's shop and can also be obtained as part of a wrapped collection of goods.

rites.name: Lanaurnes
rites.text: A shimmering victory dance that a wandering rider can perform only while wearing a particular costume. It was first offered during a seasonal reward cycle and could be earned by climbing a long ladder of achievements.

rites.name: Corinus
rites.text: A dance gesture sold in a traveling merchant's stall as part of a set of heroic guardian attire. It belongs to a collection of ceremonial motions from an older era of the realm.

rites.name: Coreostus
rites.text: A dance gesture that can be acquired through a trading stall or bundled with a mechanical companion set. It belongs to a matching collection of companions from one particular strand of reality.

rites.name: Ceollia
rites.text: A mechanic that lets a fallen wanderer take to the sky again with a sail-frame. It is available in certain tournament-style trials where no building is allowed.

rites.name: Visiastia
rites.text: A bright charge used to lift a warrior past their usual limit of growth. It can only raise a fighter to a fixed upper ceiling and no further.

rites.name: Canes
rites.text: A flashy gesture performed by a wandering figure to show off style to nearby onlookers. It can be obtained from a traveling merchant's stall and first appeared during a new age of the realm.

rites.name: Valernum Serontanum
rites.text: A mesmerizing gesture performed by a wandering performer, whose slow swaying fingers lull onlookers into a trance. It is sold at a traveling bazaar as part of a cursed trinket set.

rites.name: Serentolia
rites.text: A bright little jig performed by a character to express joy. It can be bought from a shop and belongs to a set of playful cartoon-themed moves.

rites.name: Meonestus
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs to signal a task's completion. It is part of a royal ceremonial collection and is earned by reaching a certain stage of a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Tauria Oreoses
rites.text: A gesture-style performance that a wanderer can buy from a traveling merchant's stall. It was first made available during a seasonal rotation of the market.

rites.name: Valanistum
rites.text: A carved ritual gesture that a traveler performs to signal leisure and rest in a warm bath. It can be obtained from a merchant's stall as part of a set themed around sea-riding wanderers.

rites.name: Teseollium
rites.text: A dance gesture that a performer unlocks by climbing high through a seasonal reward track. It is a playful movement shared among those who have earned it.

rites.name: Valaunanum Renia
rites.text: A carried gesture of a flame-scorched dancer that a traveler performs to show that a hot blaze has been kept alive. It belongs to a set of sunlit ceremonial gear sold among the wandering merchants.

rites.name: Seonum
rites.text: A small expressive token that a traveler can gain by reaching a particular leaf in a seasonal reward scroll. It first appeared in a newer age of the world's calendar.

rites.name: Sornia
rites.text: A small expressive token that a wanderer can claim along a particular step of a traveling guild's ranked trial. It is carried as a gesture of affection.

rites.name: Corelanum Corostasia
rites.text: A painted mark that a traveler sprays onto surfaces to show off a sticky, bouncy style. It is earned as a prize after completing a set of cheerful seasonal road journeys.

rites.name: Vanteres
rites.text: A short greeting gesture that a traveler can perform to wish others a good start to the day. It is sold in a merchant's stall as part of a set tied to a virtual performer.

rites.name: Oreonus Maseostia
rites.text: A wild rhythmic dance move that a particular character performs as a built-in gesture, awarded only to those who collect enough rewards. It is tied solely to that character's own style.

rites.name: Valolaunus
rites.text: A short celebratory gesture that a wanderer may earn as a reward from a particular traveling performer. It is tied to that performer and can only be displayed while the performer's own form is worn.

rites.name: Telenausia
rites.text: A boisterous gesture that a fighter performs to announce an upcoming battle. It can be bought from a merchant's stall or earned by placing well in a seasonal contest.

rites.name: Meorarnes
rites.text: A flashy gesture that a performer can buy from a traveling market. It was first offered during an early harvest cycle of the realm.

rites.name: Serestum
rites.text: A floating gesture performed by a wanderer to hold still in the air. It was once used by a fearsome iron-clad champion during a late seasonal trial.

rites.name: Mirasanum
rites.text: A stored gesture that a wearer can perform while bearing a particular companion's mark. It was once earned by climbing deep into a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Amianentus
rites.text: A frost-touched gesture that a wanderer can perform to show off a chilling breeze. It can be obtained from a traveling merchant's stall and first appeared in a recent seasonal cycle.

rites.name: Vantises
rites.text: A small emblem of affection that is sprayed onto surfaces. It is claimed from the first page of a reward ladder tied to a dark-blade wielder's collection within a seasonal trial of advancement.

rites.name: Tarnintia
rites.text: A cheerful gesture that a wanderer performs to signal friendly rivalry at the bat. It can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall and is sold as part of a set tied to a famed slugger.

rites.name: Ameosanes
rites.text: A shared melody that plays while people wait together in a gathering hall. It could be earned as a gift for bringing a lost companion back into the fold.

rites.name: Amontum Launtia
rites.text: A modern emote-style flourish that can be earned by completing a vow-based challenge line. It belongs to a matching collection of cosmetics tied to a ruling dominion's dawn.

rites.name: Orantes
rites.text: A gesture of mock triumph, performed by raising a blade above a pulsing crimson token. It belongs to a small collection of matching tactical charms.

rites.name: Vauneornia
rites.text: A gesture-motion that a wandering performer can unlock as a prize from a cheerful sea-creature's rewards. It is bound to that performer and works only while they are being worn.

rites.name: Taunanum Tarnum
rites.text: A small expressive gesture-token that a traveler can earn by advancing far along a seasonal reward track. It shows a mounted figure cutting through the air with a flourish.

rites.name: Valialeonor
rites.text: A flamboyant dance gesture that a wanderer can perform to show off. It is sold through a merchant's stall and has been available since an earlier cycle of the trade calendar.

rites.name: Caurium Raulania
rites.text: A floating gesture that a hovering figure performs while wearing a particular companion's costume. It belongs to a matched set and cannot be used without that figure.

rites.name: Orastum
rites.text: A dance gesture that sends a bright burst of light outward from the performer. It can be bought from a shop directly or as part of a themed bundle.

rites.name: Rollauses
rites.text: A marking sprayed onto surfaces by its bearer as a sign of mastery. It is earned by finishing the hardest trial of a sealed research chamber.

rites.name: Reosus
rites.text: A painted mark that can be sprayed onto surfaces by a wandering artist. It is earned as a reward through a set of dreamlike challenges and belongs to a collection tied to a singer.

rites.name: Orostenium
rites.text: A small emblem that a traveler can earn by climbing high through a seasonal reward track. It is painted onto surfaces as a marking of achievement.

rites.name: Taulorus
rites.text: A tireless internal stirring that quickens a bearer's motion whenever their strength is pushed to its limit. It belongs to the craft of the wayfarers who train their bodies beyond ordinary endurance.

rites.name: Oriasanum Teleolernes
rites.text: A glowing dance gesture that a festive forest guardian performs by brightening its tree-like companion. It can only be called upon while the guardian is worn.

rites.name: Vausianum
rites.text: A jaunty performer's gesture that a traveler can buy from a traders' stall or as part of a sealed wardrobe bundle. It first appeared in a seasonal revival of the realm's festivities.

rites.name: Liantes Valanum
rites.text: A relaxed dance gesture that a wearer performs to show off their style. It was once earned by reaching a high rung on a seasonal progression reward track.

rites.name: Serentanum
rites.text: A small ritual gesture that a traveler performs to wipe a blade clean. It is sold among the wares of a bundled set of masked garments.

rites.name: Amallum Torallum
rites.text: A flashy gesture that a wearer performs while wearing a particular masked figure. It can be bought in a marketplace and belongs to a themed collection of matching moves.

rites.name: Cirnestus
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a loyal companion beast while bound to its keeper. It is earned through a reward track and can only be used alongside that creature.

rites.name: Nallium
rites.text: A shared bonus that a band of allies can draw on together during their work. It was added to the craft in a later revision of the rules.

rites.name: Oriallus Valeonoles
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a performer can make by a special handheld controller. It is meant for one particular gathering held for a single guest musician.

rites.name: Seliarium
rites.text: A small, playful gesture performed by a character, sold in a merchant's stall and bundled with a grabbing tool. It belongs to a matching collection tied to a wartime calling.

rites.name: Lialenanum
rites.text: A rare gesture that a wanderer performs to rise and sway above the ground like a lifted banner. It is sold in the market and first appeared in a later age of the realm.

rites.name: Minia
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a character, sold in a shop as part of a themed bundle. It belongs to a set of ancient-beast-inspired cosmetic gestures.

rites.name: Serilus Coriantus
rites.text: A coordinated bonus granted to a whole band of allies once it is unlocked in a later stage of their campaign. It extends the protective reach of the group's shared authority across every member.

rites.name: Taror Lorentia
rites.text: A small gesture-dance a traveler can buy at the merchant stalls and perform in the open. It arrived as part of a set of hopping performances and belongs to that collection.

rites.name: Nelaunium
rites.text: A sealing gesture a traveler performs to show a closed door or hatch is secured. It can be acquired from a merchant stall and was introduced in the ninth cycle of the realm's calendar.

rites.name: Amilanum Mestanum
rites.text: A dancing gesture that a traveler unlocks by spending coins on a second tier of a seasonal reward scroll. It belongs to a matching collection of moon-themed gear worn by a sworn circle.

rites.name: Naunteorium
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs by dropping a signal-horn to the ground after finishing a long trial. It is earned by climbing to the forty-sixth rung of a seasonal ledger.

rites.name: Valiles
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to show a short rest from the day's toil. It is sold in a merchant's stall and was also awarded to those who placed well in a rowdy contest of shoves.

rites.name: Sesirnium
rites.text: A short gesture performed by a wandering figure to show off to nearby companions. It can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall and belongs to a set of matching trinkets.

rites.name: Rontialor
rites.text: A tuned-up gesture of gleaming arcane flourish that a wielder performs to show off. It is sold in a bundled set alongside a themed dark-sorcerer outfit.

rites.name: Mauriantor
rites.text: A dance gesture that a performer can unlock by advancing through the third tier of a seasonal music reward track. It is used to express joy during celebrations.

rites.name: Rausiallus
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to loosen their body. It was once a reward tied to a seasonal music journey and was introduced during a later era of the realm.

rites.name: Veolontes
rites.text: A jaunty walking dance that a courier performs to show off a bundle sold alongside a larger set of costumes. It belongs to a themed collection of cosmetic moves.

rites.name: Nolarnia
rites.text: A celebratory gesture that a traveler can perform to share joy with others. It is unlocked by progressing through the early tier of a seasonal reward track and belongs to a themed collection of matching cosmetics.

rites.name: Teloreosus
rites.text: A rare dance gesture that a character can perform, obtained through a shop listing. It first appeared during a tenth seasonal cycle.

rites.name: Vania
rites.text: A coded gesture that a wanderer can perform only during a single fleeting trial of the Quillmere Gauntlet. It is a signal crafted for that brief contest and no other.

rites.name: Mernanum
rites.text: A stylized gesture performed by a costumed wanderer, shown only while the wearer is in the mask-bearing guise. It is a signature movement tied to one particular identity.

rites.name: Niarnus Restonor
rites.text: A flashy gesture that a wanderer can buy from a traveling merchant's stall for a set price of trade tokens. It first appeared during the fourth turning of the third age of the realm.

rites.name: Corernus
rites.text: A small, playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to show off to others. It belongs to a set of gestures gathered together as part of a larger collection of rewards.

rites.name: Valornelus
rites.text: A small sprayable emblem shaped like a figure slowly losing its form. It was a reward that could be earned by climbing high enough through a seasonal progression track.

rites.name: Sirus
rites.text: A small gesture of dance that a wanderer may acquire by paying for the first page of a seasonal reward track. It is a little hovering disc-like performance.

rites.name: Meollanum
rites.text: A gleaming dance gesture that a traveler unlocks deep within a seasonal reward scroll. It was first offered during a later cycle and belongs to a golden-themed collection.

rites.name: Amonia
rites.text: A dance gesture that a small wandering performer carries as a gift, earned through a reward track. It is performed only by that performer and cannot be used by anyone else.

rites.name: Meontia Amisum
rites.text: A handheld gesture a wielder performs to stir up scattered foliage into a whirling gust. It can be acquired through a merchant's stall, either alone or bundled with a particular keeper's chest.

rites.name: Ninor Siantarnium
rites.text: A small gesture of expression that a wanderer can earn as a token of gratitude from a cunning trader. It belongs to a matching collection of charms carried by clever travelers.

rites.name: Niastosanum
rites.text: A small floating charm that a traveler can perform as a gesture in a shop-bought dance. It is sold as part of a themed bundle paired with a singer's collection of costumes.

rites.name: Colleoria
rites.text: A small playful gesture a wanderer can perform to mimic a tiny scaled beast lunging forward. It was once a possible prize from a monstrous lizard's bounty and belongs to a collection tied to a noble ruler's giant guardians.

rites.name: Reonaurium
rites.text: A reflex-based skill practiced by swift shadow-runners who trained in a certain fighting guild. It lets a practitioner launch themselves forward in a sudden, silent bound.

rites.name: Coliarium
rites.text: A flashy gesture performed by a fighter wearing a particular costume, sold in a shop and bundled with a companion's outfit. It can only be used while the matching costume is equipped.

rites.name: Teliarium
rites.text: A tiny looping gesture of a miniature carriage stuffed with jesters, sold in a shop of wares and bundled with other gestures from a merry set. It appeared during a short seasonal wave of releases.

rites.name: Oreonor
rites.text: A small, pose-like gesture a wanderer performs to show off a mechanical companion's battle stance. It could be earned by completing a chain of trials tied to a great armored guardian.

rites.name: Ameollenium
rites.text: A playful gesture that lets a wielder craft a small companion out of packed frost. It is sold in a merchant's stall and belongs to a whimsical collection of tales.

rites.name: Tornus Tiarinus
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer performs to show off a casual, carefree style. It belongs to a collection of relaxed idle motions meant for leisure.

rites.name: Amirnollum
rites.text: A signaling gesture that a traveler performs to draw the attention of nearby companions. It is earned by advancing through a seasonal reward track and belongs to a matching set of ceremonial garments.

rites.name: Serelasium
rites.text: A rare dance gesture that a performer can display for others to see. It is offered for sale in a marketplace stall and was introduced in a later year of the calendar.

rites.name: Seornus Serialus
rites.text: A small ornamental gesture-token that a wandering duelist receives as a reward from a patron's tally of favors. It is bound to one particular performer and can only be performed while that performer's own form is in use.

rites.name: Miallor
rites.text: A staged rite performed on a set built for filming, drawn from a swamp-side tradition. Prepared fragments are reused from another wetland setting.

rites.name: Naria
rites.text: A craft that lets builders shape luminous visual effects directly within a living world. It belongs to a broader engine of illusion that artisans use to dress their creations in dazzling displays.

rites.name: Seriasillia
rites.text: A short gesture performed by a figure in a bonded set, shared only by that companion while they wear its mask. It is earned by advancing through a tiered reward track.

rites.name: Tausor
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a winged wanderer performs while spinning in a slow, foreseeing circle. It can be unlocked as a reward and works only for the one who carries it.

rites.name: Lonanum
rites.text: A performed gesture that a wanderer can display to the crowd, bought from a traveling merchant's stall. It first appeared in the fifth cycle of the realm's festivals.

rites.name: Maullum Valiria
rites.text: A radiant inner glow that a wielder can call upon in a cosmetic or ornamental way. It was once offered as a reward for progressing through the first stage of a seasonal music track.

rites.name: Moreornium
rites.text: A small gesture-dance performed by a character, granted as a prize from a reward program. It is tied to a particular companion creature and can only be played while that companion is being carried.

rites.name: Tesia Costanum
rites.text: A small burst of celebratory spray that can be earned by sharing a recorded moment on a social gathering platform. It first appeared during the fourth cycle of a seasonal arena.

rites.name: Corentia Oreontus
rites.text: A glowing screen image shown while a session prepares to begin, bought from a merchant stall as part of a paired martial-duel package. It belongs to a set of fighting-themed trinkets.

rites.name: Seraulanum
rites.text: A streaked vapor-trail cosmetic that once could be unlocked through a seasonal reward track. It belongs to a matching set of storm-themed adornments.

rites.name: Serilanum Serirnum
rites.text: A playful acrobatic gesture that a wanderer performs to show off a sly trickster's spirit. It is sold in a merchant's stall as part of a set tied to a shapeshifting god of deceit.

rites.name: Telaunium
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer can perform to express cheer. It was once a reward found further along a seasonal music track, and later returned in a new cycle of the realm's contests.

rites.name: Tosternanum
rites.text: A coordinated group movement that a performer uses to blend into a crowd of others. It is sold in a merchant's stall and bundled with a masked overseer's outfit.

rites.name: Teontium Seorestium
rites.text: A glowing emote-style gesture that a wandering creature bestows as a prize for completing its trials. It appeared during a short seasonal revival of the realm's trading festivals.

rites.name: Orialles Tonaulor
rites.text: A small expressive token that a wanderer can display to signal their mood. It belongs to a shadowy collection of matching tokens and was once offered as a reward partway along a seasonal progression track.

rites.name: Mentium
rites.text: A rare gesture-dance that a wanderer can buy from a traveling merchant's stall. It first appeared during the second cycle of the second era.

rites.name: Orolium
rites.text: A fleeting combat technique that lets a wielder deliver a rapid strike while moving. It belongs to the discipline of silent wandering warriors.

rites.name: Costeolanum
rites.text: A gesture that a wielder performs by lifting unseen force. It is sold in a shop as part of a themed bundle of matching things.

rites.name: Melles Corentirium
rites.text: A swift aiming technique granted to wandering scouts in a modern frontier world. It lets a ranged user draw and steady a bow or rifle in a fraction of the usual time.

rites.name: Ceonillium
rites.text: A stealthy craft practiced by hunters who move unseen through the dark. It is held only by followers of the Dire, granting its practitioners a quiet edge in the shadows.

rites.name: Valerilanum
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a wanderer who leaps across shallow pools of rainwater. It is sold among the wares of a traveling merchant's stall.

rites.name: Meornia
rites.text: A mind-based gesture practice in which a wielder coaxes unseen inner currents into motion through the hands. It arrived as part of a larger ensemble of arcane performances.

rites.name: Rarneonium
rites.text: A gesture of a wanderer who slows the world around them to a crawl and dodges projectiles in mid-air. It is sold alongside a rabbit-themed bundle.

rites.name: Teleornium
rites.text: A triumphant gesture that can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall, either alone or within a bundle of courage-themed gear. It once could be earned by climbing high in a seasonal competition.

rites.name: Vaunteostum
rites.text: A playful gesture that a wanderer performs to show delight at a bundle of leafy greens. It is sold in a traveling merchant's stall and was also earned by reaching an advanced rung of a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Saurontus
rites.text: A silent discipline of the shadow-trained warriors that grants a practiced fighter an extra edge in their craft. It was once a common technique but has since been set aside and forgotten.

rites.name: Sinor Ceollus
rites.text: A gesture of readiness that a warrior can perform to signal a companion. It is unlocked through a tiered progression ledger and belongs to a set of shadow-operative gestures.

rites.name: Taurniasum
rites.text: A rhythmic dance motion that a wandering performer uses while wearing her signature outfit. It can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall and is tied to one specific character's garb.

rites.name: Mestinus
rites.text: A quiet gesture a wandering scholar performs while holding an open book, earned as a reward for loyal service. It can only be used by the one who first learned it from a particular keeper of the house.

rites.name: Veornellium
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture performed by a soldier who has just arrived at a post. It belongs to a set of ritual gestures sharing a common theme.

rites.name: Castor
rites.text: A reclining gesture performed by a wanderer who leans back as if resting on an invisible jet of air. Those who earn it through a contest of skill may display it in the marketplace of the realm.

rites.name: Lostintum
rites.text: A bold dance gesture that a performer can buy from a shop and show off. It belongs to a matching collection of gestures tied to one famous musician.

rites.name: Valleontia
rites.text: A small playful expression token that a wanderer earns as a gift from a traveling patron. It belongs to a matched collection of howling tokens.

rites.name: Rentium Rauntia
rites.text: A ritual gesture of a tennis champion, performed by an athlete with a raised racket before a decisive strike. It is sold in a merchant's stall as part of a celebrity's set.

rites.name: Corilarnum
rites.text: A ceremonial dance gesture bound to a single wearer, taught to be performed only by her after a triumph. It is sold in a shared marketplace and belongs to a larger collection of fighting-themed motions.

rites.name: Telantus
rites.text: A method of burrowing through loose dunes that lets travelers move quickly and without being seen. It was devised in a later age of the wandering tribes.

rites.name: Restium Ciror
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture performed by a practitioner who rises from a seated posture in a rhythmic, disciplined motion. It is sold through a merchant's stall and was first offered during the seventh cycle of the year.

rites.name: Ameonium Misteoles
rites.text: A gesture of hunting through the grass for hidden traces, performed by a wanderer. It is acquired through a merchant's stall or bundled with a set of mystery-solving companions.

rites.name: Tantus Volliastium
rites.text: A hidden gesture that a sworn guardian performs while wearing a borrowed face. It belongs to a sealed set of relics and works only when that face is worn.

rites.name: Rausinus
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a wandering figure in a modern bazaar. It can be acquired from a merchant's stall, sometimes bundled alongside a companion set of similar motions.

rites.name: Vallauntium
rites.text: A small gesture of a squat, leaping amphibian that a wanderer can earn by climbing to the highest rung of a seasonal trial. It belongs to a collection of rites tied to a single set of spirit-bound practices.

rites.name: Taria Meseolus
rites.text: A modern gesture performed by a figure who jabs and weaves at an unseen opponent. It is sold in a marketplace stall and first appeared during an eighth cycle of play.

rites.name: Ciles Orauntallia
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a figure who forms a hound from silhouetted hands against a glowing wall. It belongs to a set of performances sold alongside a companion figure's outfit.

rites.name: Cintes
rites.text: A signature gesture carried by a masked shapechanging figure, usable only while that figure's disguise is worn. It was offered as a reward for completing a set of trials.

rites.name: Oriarilum
rites.text: A short performed gesture that can be bought from a merchant's stall, sold alone or as part of a paired set with a companion. It belongs to a collection of gestures tied to a band of meddling investigators.

rites.name: Teornantia
rites.text: A glowing trail of light that follows a warrior through the sky. It was once offered as a reward tied to a set of matching gear.

rites.name: Seoles
rites.text: A nimble sidestep dance move that is bound to one particular wearer and belongs to a matching collection of attire. It can only be performed while that wearer's costume is worn.

rites.name: Seresor Vausiror
rites.text: A flowing, rhythmic gesture that wanderers perform to show ease and grace. It is sold through a traveling merchant's stall and bundled with a companion's kit.

rites.name: Mellus Sirium
rites.text: A rhythmic dance motion that a wanderer can perform, earned as a gift from a forest keeper's ledger of rewards. It is bound to that keeper and works only while the keeper's own signature movement is in use.

rites.name: Valaror Lauleonanum
rites.text: A playful gesture a wanderer performs by twirling a placard in a lively spin. It is earned by advancing through the upper ranks of a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Reollum Seontum
rites.text: A small gesture of a damp, snapping hand that a traveler can perform in the open world. It can be bought at a merchant stall or gained as a reward for placing well in a seasonal contest.

rites.name: Mausoria
rites.text: A dance-like gesture that a wanderer can perform to move sideways in a quick, rhythmic step. It is sold at a merchant stall and was introduced during a later era of the realm.

rites.name: Valeornia Amisiantia
rites.text: A flashy performance gesture that a wanderer can buy at a traveling market or bundle with a matching chest of gear. It first appeared during a seasonal cycle of the realm.

rites.name: Listus Tarnia
rites.text: A dance gesture that a traveler can perform, once earned from a seasonal reward track. It belongs to a matched collection of gestures tied to escaping a gravity pull.

rites.name: Rentium Lostelia
rites.text: A stylized performance gesture that a wandering bard acts out to show off a rhythmic strummed instrument. It belongs to a set of eerie guardian trappings.

rites.name: Ciraunes
rites.text: A small handheld gesture that a wanderer performs to show off a flash of sharp insight. It is sold through a traveling market and bundled with a sly trickster's set of trinkets.

rites.name: Corauntor
rites.text: A dance gesture that a traveler can buy from a market stall, often as part of a bundle with other gestures. It belongs to a set linked to a famous performer's style.

rites.name: Sirnentor
rites.text: A rare dance gesture that a traveler could earn by climbing to the thirty-first rung of a seasonal reward ladder. It lets the performer show off a sparkling flourish to others.

rites.name: Amiasiles
rites.text: A short flourish performed by a wanderer upon arriving at a settlement, sold through a traveling merchant's stall. It belongs to a matched collection of ceremonial gestures.

rites.name: Velus
rites.text: A small emote-token that a wanderer could earn by completing winter trial-tasks. It shows a figure flinging a burst of cold flakes into the air.

rites.name: Corisaurnum
rites.text: A stylized gesture that a character performs in play, though it is not yet available to anyone. It is a playful expressive action meant to show off a person's mood.

rites.name: Mianor Casum
rites.text: A purchasable bundle sold at a merchant stall, granting its bearer a short burst of swift momentum. It arrived in a later age of the realm and comes bundled with its own surge relic.

rites.name: Valiarium
rites.text: A flashy rising strike gesture bound to one particular fighter, usable only while that warrior is equipped. It is sold in a shop and grouped with a set of matching fighter gestures.

rites.name: Orilia Meseorium
rites.text: A flickering gesture of sudden, sparking contact that a wanderer can perform to signal a companion. It is sold in a merchant's stall alongside a paired charm bundle.

rites.name: Amaunostium
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a wanderer to show joy. It was earned by climbing the rewards ladder of a seasonal celebration pass.

rites.name: Ciastanum
rites.text: A signature gesture a fighter can perform to show off their skill. It is earned by advancing far through a seasonal progression track of rewards.

rites.name: Virnium Miaraullium
rites.text: A gesture performed by a figure in a shared arena, earned as a reward within a seasonal music track. It appeared first in a later cycle of the realm.

rites.name: Oreolum
rites.text: A playful gesture that a character performs to show off a carefree, zig-zagging sweep of movement. It can be acquired from a traded storefront and was introduced in the third era of the realm.

rites.name: Amilus Seriastor
rites.text: A silent hand-sign performed by a wearer of a particular masked champion, meant to quiet the crowd. It can only be made while that champion's mask is worn.

rites.name: Losus
rites.text: A brief rush of boundless endurance that a wanderer can draw on for a short span. It appears as a recent innovation within a contest of last ones standing.

rites.name: Ristares
rites.text: A coiling dance gesture that a wanderer performs to show their skill. It was earned by those who advanced far through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Corernaunus
rites.text: A rare gesture a traveler performs to show a foul odor hanging in the air. Merchants stock it in their bazaar, and it arrived in the sixth age.

rites.name: Vistum Serosauria
rites.text: A dance gesture a traveler can buy from a market stall, shown as part of a set tied to a famed strongman. It belongs to a bundle of matching performance trinkets.

rites.name: Valoreoses
rites.text: A small expressive gesture token that a traveler can earn by climbing to a high rank within a seasonal reward ladder. It is one of the less common tokens a wanderer may collect.

rites.name: Serarnes Cornaulum
rites.text: A short performed gesture that a wanderer can buy from a traveling merchant stall. It is bundled together with a companion set of similar gestures.

rites.name: Nauranium
rites.text: A dance-like gesture that a wanderer performs by spinning on a hovering board. It can be obtained through a merchant's stall or as part of a satellite-themed set.

rites.name: Coriallum
rites.text: A gesture that a traveler performs to climb onto another's shoulders, letting companions rise one above the other. It was introduced in a later revision of the world's rules to allow stacking.

rites.name: Coraullia Amesteonia
rites.text: A gesture-dance performed only by a bearer who wears a certain armored champion. It was earned through trials of a rival guild and is bound to that single warrior.

rites.name: Lesor Ciasornes
rites.text: A gesture of rising weightlessness that a figure performs to display themselves. It can be acquired through a merchant's stall and first appeared in a recent era of the world.

rites.name: Oraustia Valiarnum
rites.text: A flashy gesture that a wanderer performs to show off a skimming, wave-riding motion. It can be acquired through a traveling merchant's bundle.

rites.name: Niaror
rites.text: A savage gesture performed by a clawed beast-warrior who wears its own armored hunter form. It is bound to that form and can only be shown while the wearer is in it.

rites.name: Rasistia
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs to gather inner force before a burst of power. It can only be shown by the one who carries its bearer's mark.

rites.name: Vausania
rites.text: A crowd gesture that spreads from one ringing spectator to the next in a rolling motion. It is one of several gestures that a performer may be assigned at random during a contest of nimble racers.

rites.name: Vesontia
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a wanderer performs to show a bond with ancestral spirits. It belongs to a collection of linked gestures tied to a single set.

rites.name: Taullus Coroneles
rites.text: A small playful gesture a wanderer performs while wearing a particular companion. It is bound to that companion and cannot be shared with anyone else.

rites.name: Riareosum
rites.text: A gesture that a character performs to signal readiness to begin an activity. It can be acquired through a merchant's shop for a price.

rites.name: Nantaurus
rites.text: A communal boon that a band of allies can share in their shared work. It grants them a small advantage whenever they work together as a team.

rites.name: Tolum Lornia
rites.text: A bouncing dance gesture that a character performs while riding a slick, cold drink across a flat surface. It can be acquired through a rotating shop or as part of a themed collection of cosmetic bundles.

rites.name: Mantes Valantenia
rites.text: A playful gesture performed by a costumed brawler in a dazzling arena. It is sold in a shop and can only be used while wearing its owner.

rites.name: Tirus Valeonium
rites.text: A practiced craft in which a fighter keeps a steady volley of projectiles poured across a region, forcing foes to stay low and hold their ground. It is taught as a combat talent that sharpens a warrior's standing in battle.

rites.name: Losernes
rites.text: A ranged marksman's knack that steadies the aim of nearby allies, improving the chance their shots land true during a skirmish.

rites.name: Mantus
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture performed by a wearer of a certain costume set, usable only while that costume is worn. It is tied to a single bearer and a reward path earned through a seasonal progression track.

rites.name: Vornines
rites.text: A ceremonial gesture that a warrior performs while donning a sealed armored shell. It can only be done by the armor's bearer, and it is paired with a particular champion.

rites.name: Teollernium
rites.text: A showy foot-flinging gesture that a wanderer performs to signal triumph. It can be bought from a merchant's stall or as part of a rabbit-themed bundle.

rites.name: Velistum
rites.text: A small expressive gesture-signal carried by wanderers in a modern cosmopolitan city. It is a symbol of affection, shown through a pair of raised hands forming a heart, and it belongs to a wider set of signs that share one theme.

rites.name: Teliarnium Sereostanum
rites.text: A flashy gesture performed by a wandering dancer to show off their rhythm. It was earned by climbing the upper rungs of a seasonal festival of performers.

rites.name: Amasollor
rites.text: A gesture that a wanderer performs to show quiet watching and interest. Earlier holders of an old tune were the first to be granted this manner of performing it.

rites.name: Lialum
rites.text: A rhythmic gesture that a rider performs while seated atop a pastel steed. It is earned as a gift from a reward ledger and is bound to that one mount.

rites.name: Viranum Corantium
rites.text: A rhythmic bodily gesture performed by a figure in a playful display. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall and first appeared in the third cycle of the realm's festivals.

rites.name: Taules Amirnus
rites.text: A rare gesture that a traveler can perform to show shared purpose with others. It is sold in a bundle alongside other cosmetic gear at a traders' shop.

rites.name: Serillostor
rites.text: A flourish of gesture that a performer can unlock through a tiered reward track. It belongs to a matched pair of rotating platters.

rites.name: Rantostor
rites.text: A stylized gesture performed by a wielder to show off routine practice movements. It is sold in a shop and belongs to a matched collection of gestures tied to a single faction of hired blades.

rites.name: Lases Marnorus
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that a traveler could earn by completing a set of challenges in a seasonal competition. It was introduced in the later part of a fifth era of play.

rites.name: Sintanum
rites.text: A soldier's discipline that rewards a run of three downed foes with sharper shots and steadier aim. Each further takedown renews its brief surge.

rites.name: Neollestor
rites.text: A dramatic posing gesture that a wanderer performs to display confidence. It is not yet available for anyone to use.

rites.name: Cintosum
rites.text: A set of rule-altering conditions that reshape how a timed assault unfolds. Any task carrying these conditions is labeled a Mutant Storm Task.

rites.name: Sastanum Tauntiasus
rites.text: A ritual cry that a hunter releases as a signal, bound to a set of gear and earned only after a long climb through a seasonal reward track.

rites.name: Costaunanum
rites.text: A short dancing gesture that a masked caster performs, tied to her hooded companion. It can be bought in a shop and is only usable while wearing that companion.

rites.name: Mestes Rineosus
rites.text: A flourish that a wielder performs by sending a sharp, echoing crack through the air. It is sold in a merchant's stall and belongs to a set of garments from a shadowed city.

rites.name: Cialauntia
rites.text: A short hand-raised greeting gesture that a performer can display to others. It is sold in a merchant's shop and belongs to a matched collection of gestures.

rites.name: Caselor
rites.text: A dance gesture bought from a merchant's stall, sold as part of a royal bundle and tied to a musical performer's collection.

rites.name: Teles
rites.text: A dance gesture that a wanderer can perform to show joy. It was once granted to those who visited a certain gathering during a short window of days.

rites.name: Leornus
rites.text: A small expressive gesture that a wearer can flash to others, drawn from a noble's set of matching gestures. It belongs to a court-themed collection of such signals.

rites.name: Sernanum Santeornium
rites.text: A stealthy gesture that a wanderer performs to signal quiet cunning. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall or as part of a hairy wilderness trove.

rites.name: Coranum Serostor
rites.text: A lively dance gesture that a performer can show off to others. It is sold in a shop for a fee and was introduced during a fifth cycle of seasonal content.

rites.name: Rosanum Ameolles
rites.text: A rare gesture-dance that a wanderer performs to playfully ask where a missing companion has gone. It can be bought from a traveling merchant's stall.

rites.name: Sastinium
