rites.text: A celebratory gesture that a wanderer can perform to show off a triumph. It can be acquired from a traveling merchant's stall, either alone or bundled with a performer's signature set.

rites.name: Telostium Sollus
rites.text: A dramatic gesture performed by a wearer of a bonded shadow-creature, the act is sold in a traveling merchant's stall and belongs to a set of similar bonded-creature gestures. It is tied exclusively to one specific bearer.

rites.name: Cirnausium
rites.text: A small, bright gesture that a wanderer performs to show triumph. It can be bought from a traveling merchant or earned by climbing high in a seasonal contest.

rites.name: Riantoranum
rites.text: A trailing streak of light that a wanderer may earn by climbing high through a seasonal reward track. It hangs behind the traveler as a bright vapor ribbon.

rites.name: Coraulor Lornauses
rites.text: A gesture a wanderer performs to greet others and ask where they are headed. It is sold at a traveling merchant stall and was first introduced during a new cycle of the realm.

rites.name: Corollor Teliarnes
rites.text: A spinning gesture of playful motion that a character performs to express cheer. It can be acquired through a shop that sells such expressions.

rites.name: Ciantillum
rites.text: A gesture-style performance a wielder can display to others, sold through a traveling merchant's stall. It belongs to a set of matching trinkets from a particular collection.

rites.name: Amontus
rites.text: A bold ceremonial gesture that a wrestler-styled traveler performs to rally a crowd. It is sold in the market as part of a paired set of two figures' gear.

rites.name: Lausernia
rites.text: A spinning ceremonial emblem that a wanderer can perform as a gesture of celebration. It is sold through a traveling merchant's stall as part of a paired offering of charms.

rites.name: Serillum Risus
rites.text: A bold gesture that a warrior performs to gather energy before striking. It is bound to one particular fighter and can only be shown while that fighter is worn.

rites.name: Tiaraustor
rites.text: A rare dance gesture that a wanderer can perform in a shop of the far marketplace. It first appeared in the ninth turning of the cycle.

rites.name: Ciallostia
rites.text: A movement technique that lets a traveler lunge forward swiftly from a resting stance. It arrived later in a period of contests, sharing an arena-clash setting.

rites.name: Amiarus Orenteostes
rites.text: A rhythmic gesture performed by a figure in a blocky world, earned by climbing a seasonal reward track. It is shown by one body held in a sideways posture.

rites.name: Rialases
rites.text: A flashy gesture performed by a bold ruler's courtiers to show off their style. It belongs to a matching set tied to a notorious thief queen.

rites.name: Riarintus
rites.text: A gesture that a wielder performs to show off a triumphant display. It is sold in a shop as part of a matching set of gear and can also be earned by winning a competitive tournament.

rites.name: Coniarnor
rites.text: A shared gesture that a wearer performs only while bearing a particular symbiotic mask-creature. It is earned through a shop purchase or by ranking high in a seasonal contest.

rites.name: Lenintus
rites.text: A calm gesture performed by a small absorbent cloth-creature once it is equipped. It is earned through a reward track tied to that creature and cannot be performed by any other figure.

rites.name: Maurnia Valentonium
rites.text: A playful gesture that can be bought from a shop, either alone or as part of a themed bundle. It belongs to a set of matching cosmetic items.

rites.name: Sereostia Telaurium
rites.text: A gesture of communal loyalty performed by a traveler to show lasting devotion to a fellow crew. It can be acquired from a merchant stall, either alone or bundled with a matching set of garments.

rites.name: Vallenes
rites.text: A short, lively dance routine that a wearer performs to show off a fresh burst of energy. It is sold through a shop and bundled with a matching costume set.

rites.name: Mirnor Nauriarnia
rites.text: A stylized movement routine that a wanderer can buy from a traveling merchant's stall. It is sold alone or bundled with a set of matching trinkets.

rites.name: Valilor
rites.text: A gesture that a wanderer might perform as a quick expression of feeling. It belongs to a set of seven matching gestures.

rites.name: Amirnum
rites.text: A ritual hand-sign performed in a playful dance-like motion. It was once earned by completing a challenge trial and belongs to a set of matching ceremonial trappings.

rites.name: Coreonia Maulia
rites.text: A gesture performed by a wandering frost-caller to mark the bond of a sworn circle. It is earned by completing the second tier of a seasonal tribute scroll and belongs to a sealed set of court rites.

rites.name: Seriarium Meosanium
rites.text: A glacial barrier that can be summoned on a whim to shield its wielder and allies. It holds a large store of endurance and stays intact until fully destroyed, and it can knock back and topple nearby foes.

rites.name: Teliloranum
rites.text: A silent gesture that a traveler performs to fade from sight for a moment. It is sold in a bundled set alongside other companion charms from a traveling band of protectors.

rites.name: Ristaulum
rites.text: A bellowing signal sung by a hairy giant from a forest tribe, performed as a gesture that belongs to that one fighter alone. It can only be shown while that fighter is worn.

rites.name: Sinanum Mosteollia
rites.text: A gesture of spite that a wearer performs while bound to a particular companion figure. It can only be called upon when that figure is worn.

rites.name: Amesistanum
rites.text: A temporary enhancement that lasts until its bearer gathers a set amount of accumulated experience, regardless of how long they have held it. Allies sharing the surge are affected in the same manner.

rites.name: Tantolor
rites.text: A glowing gesture performed by wearers of a particular costume set, shared through a marketplace of wares. It can only be used while those garments are worn.

rites.name: Amirnastus
rites.text: Amirnastus is a sacred tithe-ceremony of the Maurantium age, in which devotees bind their oath-tokens to a chosen herald for a fixed span of seasons before the bond lapses and must be renewed or redirected. Its tides of devotion ripple through the realm's markets and courts, reshaping which heralds rise and fall. Chroniclers record it as the quiet engine behind the Mythic era's shifting fortunes.

rites.name: Amosarnia
rites.text: Amosarnia is a mythic conduit of Maurantium's sixth age, a pair of silver-threaded gauntlets forged from the cooled heartstone of a dead sun. Its wielders can channel stored starlight into a single devastating discharge, though each use drains the bearer's memories of their own childhood.

rites.name: Telasium
rites.text: Telasium is a crystalline resonance drawn from the fractured song of the Maurantine twilight, used by sky-cartographers to unlock dormant sealed valleys. Its strongest pulse can split a mid-sized moon's crust, though it is usually channeled into gentle harmonic tuning. Lesser forms serve as lanterns and ward-chimes.

rites.name: Amellanum
rites.text: Amellanum is a concept of hardened thorn-glass woven from the marrow of dying ash-trees, drawn into shielding ribbons that bloom only when a strike threatens the bearer. Chroniclers of the Mythic era record it as a bulwark that turns a single blow into a thousand shards, though its wielders pay in slowly withering limbs.

rites.name: Ventaranum
rites.text: Ventaranum is a sealed resonance-lattice woven into the stone spine of the Maurantine highlands, its pulses tuned to bend the wind-currents above it. Its dormant state keeps the valley calm, but its awakened form can hurl gusts that split granite ridges and push seas back from the coast.

rites.name: Salles
rites.text: Salles is a resonant mythic discipline in Maurantium's third age, a way of tuning the ambient hum of the old lattice into a single coherent pulse of force. Its practitioners are called Tuners, and their most feared technique is a chorus-strike that can fracture stone and overturn the currents of a sea.

rites.name: Casteolium
rites.text: Casteolium is a mythic tier of inscribed wardstones forged in the Maurantium era E6, each one humming with a stored charge that its bearer can unleash in a single cataclysmic pulse. The stones are said to have been cast from the ash of a dying sun, and their wielders are chosen by the stones rather than by any ritual.

rites.name: Rornium
rites.text: Rornium is a veil-thread woven by the silent weavers of Maurantium, drawn from the hush between dying echoes. It lets the wearer slip out of sight of anything that hunts by sound or light, and its stored hush can bleed away enough force to shrug off a star's dying flare.

rites.name: Oraullor
rites.text: Oraullor is a concept of resonant bone-fire that the people of Maurantium describe as a single clenched vow held across centuries. Its practitioners can gather a sky's worth of lightning into a closed fist and loose it as a blow that splits mountain ridges. The discipline is rare because each use draws down the practitioner's own lifespan.

rites.name: Ciastia
rites.text: Ciastia is a veiled tempest-spirit of the Maurantium mythic age, a concept born when sky-wardens first bottled gale into clay vessels. Its essence can be unsealed to hurl a cyclone that tears roofs from distant hamlets and scatters flocks across the plains.

rites.name: Serostum
rites.text: Serostum is a mythic pulse of compressed dusk that the peoples of Maurantium call the seventh breath of the drowned sun. It is worn as a glove of hardened twilight that a bearer may swing to tear open sealed vaults and fold the air around a fallen comrade.

rites.name: Virnus
rites.text: Virnus is a Mythic-era power in the Maurantium omniverse, a bound resonance that lets its wielder unmake the tethers holding ordinary matter together. It was forged in the cooling echoes of the E6 age and lingers as a restless current in the powers realm. Its bearers are said to hear the hum of stars just before their light dims.

rites.name: Neostes Coreoraules
rites.text: A pure light force that breaks matter apart, reshapes it, and rebuilds it through a crystalline catalyst called morphite. It was first glimpsed in the old trials before spreading to the wider realm.

rites.name: Pelurnen
rites.text: Pelurnen is the concept of a branching ending in Maurantium's Three Futures, the moment when one outcome splits into many and the Library shelves each one. It has no body, only the weight of choices that were never made, which it can tilt toward a single road.

rites.name: Khaiggurn
rites.text: Khaiggurn is a concept of the Maurantium Mythic Realm during the Era of the Record, personified as the shelf-keeper who files each branch of the Three Futures. Its power is to hold a finished outcome in place long enough to be read, and it can strike with enough force to tear a branch from its root.

rites.name: Oreostus
rites.text: Oreostus is the concept of a branching ending, the pull that splits the Three Futures apart and keeps each outcome shelved in the Library of Maurantium. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds between the peoples, Oreostus was said to tip the scale whenever a choice hung unresolved.
